name: soup-or-bill
title: soup-or-bill
blurb: a road-to-empress-style dialogue-menu game: you're a bay area tech exec and a stream of very friendly strangers keep wanting to talk shop. parry them with enough WIS, dodge the power bill (arrest) and the soup (assassination). asked for by norvid-studies.bsky.social, with a nod to cee.wtf's high-WIS parry run.
